content: faer API stability and release history: faer 0.18 was a major consolidation (multiple crates into one). 0.19 simplified matrix constructors (added _generic prefix variants for old behavior, renamed fill_with_zero to fill_zeros). 0.22 renamed bunch-kaufman to lblt. Breaking changes occur roughly every 2-4 versions during 0.18-0.22; 0.23.x appears more stable. MSRV is 1.84.0. Single maintainer: sarah quinones (sarah@veganb.tw). Repository moved to Codeberg (codeberg.org/sarah-quinones/faer). The SVD and Mat construction API (thin_svd, from_column_major_slice) has been stable since 0.18. faer rayon feature is in default features; the linalg feature in fdars uses faer with default features (rayon included per Cargo.lock). Bus factor: single maintainer is a risk for a library this specialized.
